parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by copying the data limits from the original axis to the twin axis. This should prevent the data limits from being set to ±inf when a stackplot is added to the twin axis.

issues.description: The patch introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the data limits of the twin axis. This could potentially lead to unexpected behavior if the twin axis is intended to have its own data limits.
